_comment: Physical Education and Sport -- Secondary Teachers' Diploma syllabus. First typeset
2026-10-12. Layout, numbering and spelling repairs only: NONE of these rewrites a
competence, an activity or an expected standard.
FILE NAME. Received as 'PHYSICAL EDUCATION AND SPORT VALIDATED CONTENT TED FINALISED
2026 - Shepherd Chanda Lukosha.docx'. The working copy is named in the family's pattern
(VALIDATED <SUBJECT> <LEVEL> SYLLABUS - <Author>), which is what the engine reads the
subject and level from. The level, 'Secondary Teachers' Diploma', is the manuscript's
own cover wording.
NUMBERING (renumberMatrix). Not one number in the matrix or in the scope and sequence
chart is typed: all are Word list numbers, and the lists are broken -- they restart,
change list mid-topic and go on counting inside the merged cells under a topic. As it
stood the Year 1 topic column read 1.1, 1.2, (1.3 in an empty cell), 1.4, 1.5, 1.5,
1.6, 1.12 SWIMMING, 1.7 FITNESS AND HEALTH, 1.9, 1.10 beside sub-topics 1.1.x ...
1.10.x; Year 2 read 2.1, 2.2, 2.3, 2.10 SPORTS MANAGEMENT, 2.11, 2.12 beside sub-topics
cell; the chart ran its Year 1 topics up to 1.28. The matrix and the chart are numbered
from their structure instead, in the family's format: topic Y.k, sub-topic Y.k.j,
competence Y.k.j.m. Result: Year 1 topics 1.1-1.10, Year 2 topics 2.1-2.6, and the
chart's topic numbers agree with the matrix. Titles and wording are untouched.
STILL OUTSTANDING -- needs the author, not the typesetter:
* Confirm the numbering (above).
* The year headings: the manuscript heads the first matrix 'FORM 1 (ONE)' and the
second 'YEAR 2', and its cover says 'FORM 1 - 2'. Set as YEAR 1 / YEAR 2, as the
manuscript's own scope and sequence chart has them.
* The scope and sequence chart does not match the matrix in its sub-topics. Year 1:
Anatomy lists 'Energy production' and 'Body Recovery after exercise' (in the matrix
these are under Year 2, Sports Nutrition); Swimming lists Pool orientation / pool
hygiene / Basic water safety / Water games / Coaching and officiating roles (matrix:
Pool orientation and hygiene / Strokes / Survival skills in the pool / Basic water
safety and survival skills in the pool / Coaching and officiating roles);
Biomechanics lists five sub-topics (Types of levers ... Projectile motion) where the
matrix has eight (Introduction to Biomechanics ... Application of Biomechanics in
Teaching and Coaching); Recreational games has 'Dance and movement' (matrix:
'Movement'); Physical Education and Health has three sub-topics, the matrix a fourth
with no title. Year 2: Psychology of sport lists 'Theories of psychology of sport'
twice; Sports nutrition lists one sub-topic where the matrix has three. The chart's
topic 1.2 is titled 'Anatomy and Physiology of Physical Education and Sport', the
matrix's 'Anatomy and Physiology'.
* Year 1, Anatomy and Physiology: the matrix has ten empty lines under 'The human
Body systems' where the chart lists the six systems.
* Year 1, Physical Education and Health: the competence 'Discuss management of
financial resources in Physical Education and Sport' sits under the sub-topic
Environmental Protection (the sub-topic cell is merged over both rows).
* Year 1, Athletics events: its second and third competences shared the merged
sub-topic cell; they are numbered 1.6.2.2 and 1.6.2.3.
* Year 1, Biomechanics 'Levers and Mechanical Advantage': the expected standard
reads 'Speed in sporting activities illustrated correctly'. Two further standards
are unfinished sentences: 'Factors affecting balance and stability in sport' and
'Biomechanical principles into Physical integrated accordingly'.
* Year: the cover says 2023, the copyright line 2025. The copyright line is set as
written; the cover carries no year.
* RECOMMENDED REFERENCES: the last entry stops mid-word ('Jones and Bartlett P'), and
the entries mix bold, bold-italic and plain titles. Set as written. Several
PRESCRIBED REFERENCES carry notes to self ('Authors not specified in search', 'not
in search results', 'Year of Publication').
_deleteExact_why: The ISBN is printed by the engine's imprint (from `isbn` above); the manuscript's own line, and the heading of its empty hand-made contents, were left standing under the generated contents.

setHeading._why: The first year's banner. The manuscript calls it 'FORM 1 (ONE)' and the next one 'YEAR 2'; its scope and sequence chart says YEAR 1 / YEAR 2 (see _comment).

pageBreakBefore._why: The last two lines of SUGGESTED TEACHING METHODOLOGIES fell alone on the page before the level divider. Its two closing paragraphs now go over together.
pageBreakBefore.find: The teacher should have reasons for choosing a particular teaching method

pageBreakBefore._why: The last entry of RECOMMENDED REFERENCES fell alone on the last page of the book. The list is two alphabetical runs typed one after the other (Burke ... Sommer, then Beashel ... Pfeiffer); the second run now opens the last page.
pageBreakBefore.find: Beashel, P; Sibson, A. and Taylor, J. (1984)

editCell._why: The first letter of the header is missing in the manuscript.
